CI run 43008212228 records the same failure. One fix is to make that test also set aside the `role need` lines; that test file is outside the deliverables, so the brief would have to allow it. The other is to not print the planner line when planning is unused, which loses the every-role line criterion 4 requires. Either way the producer had to resolve it before handing off.

findings.summary: Outcomes outside the specified mapping count as successful work in the class failure ratio.
findings.evidence: `_ => Some(false)` counts Blocked, Stale, Dropped and Abandoned as successes. An abandoned or dropped job says nothing about whether the work succeeded, yet it adds to a class's denominator and lowers its failure share. Excluding these states (None), like Declined and Closed, or treating Abandoned as failed, would be more accurate. The reading only specified Failed/Rejected/TimedOut and Declined/Closed, so this is minor.
